note: Stamped after the fact for IBM rows already committed. The scenario digest and malariasimulation version are computed from the current checkout; the date is when the stamp was made, not when every row was generated. run_replicates.R writes this file itself from now on. The digest was rebuilt on 2026-09-11: it previously hashed a serialised R object and then full-precision doubles, so it fingerprinted the machine (R version, platform, floating-point last digits from set_equilibrium's numerical solve) as much as the scenarios and could never match in CI. It now hashes canonical text with doubles rounded to 12 significant figures. The scenarios themselves have not changed and the IBM rows are untouched. scenario_digests gives the per-scenario breakdown so a mismatch names the culprit.
